observation.visible_scene: A wide view of a sunset (or sunrise) sky: a teal-green upper sky streaked with clouds lit orange-pink from a low sun glowing near the left-center horizon. Dark silhouetted rooftops and treetops line the bottom edge. The camera is fixed; the building and tree silhouettes stay in identical pixel positions throughout.
visible_changes: The cloud formations drift and subtly deform slowly across the sky from frame 1 to frame 41 (e.g., the elongated pink cloud near the upper center shifts slightly left/up and the banded clouds on the right creep leftward), indicating gentle wind motion rather than camera movement.
A small dark bird silhouette with spread wings is visible in the upper-right of frame 1 and is absent by frame 2, so it exits the view very early.
Occasional tiny dark specks (likely distant birds) appear briefly in some frames (e.g., near the center in frame 24, on the right in frame 27) and then vanish.
The sun's bright glow and the overall color balance remain essentially constant; the dark cloud bank over the sun shifts only marginally.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the cloud drift continues at the same rate before frame 1 or after frame 41.
The full flight path or destination of the bird seen only in frame 1.
uncertain_details: The exact speed and direction of cloud motion is hard to measure over this short excerpt; motion is slow and continuous.
Some small dark dots may be birds, sensor noise, or compression artifacts rather than definite objects.
It is unclear whether this is real-time footage or a sped-up timelapse.
